NIFTY First Hour Favour · breakout on 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m · 2026-03-21 → 2026-09-20

Step 1 — the first hour 09:15–10:14 closes GREEN → arm LONG, RED → arm SHORT (a flat close arms nothing). Step 2 — cn is the first candle from 10:15 to 14:00 whose CLOSE is beyond the first hour's high (long) or low (short). Step 3 — entry is the OPEN of cn+1. Step 4 — SL is cn's low (long) or cn's high (short). Step 5 — Risk = |Entry − SL|, Target = Entry ± Risk × RR.
The first hour is the same on every timeframe; what the timeframe changes is the candle that triggers and the candle that confirms the stop. Squared off at 15:25 if still open. Targets and touch-stops are resolved on 1-minute data, so an intrabar target is taken before that bar's close can trigger a close-confirmed stop; within one minute the stop is taken first.
Money is the ATM option the signal implies (CE long, PE short), one lot of 65, bought at the entry minute's HIGH and sold at the exit minute's LOW, then brokerage and statutory charges. 122 sessions, 87 of them produced a trade.
